context: Yuki returns from overseas permanently, visits Naoko.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 直子さん、ついに、帰ってきた。
lines.style: Soft opening, almost wonderous. Warm recognition in the voice. Gentle pace, letting each word land. The relief of seeing someone loved after a long absence.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Welcome home — I'm so happy you're back.
lines.style: Full-hearted warmth, no hesitation. A small smile audible in the opening. Steady, present delivery. The sincerity of someone who has been waiting and means every word.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外、長かった、けど、戻れて、安心。
lines.en: It was such a long time overseas, but I'm relieved to be back.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective. A slight pause before 'relieved' — gathering the weight of the experience. Warm exhale at the end. Genuine, not performance.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 友達、ずっと、繋がってた。
lines.en: I stayed connected to you the whole time, you know.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not bragging — stating a fact about care. Slight lean-in quality. Warm, steady eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Soft, earnest. The weight of gratitude without dramatics. Slight tremor of genuine feeling. Voice trails gently, like she's still taking it in.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 一緒に、これからも、過ごしたい。
lines.en: I want to spend time with you — from now on.
lines.style: Promise underneath. Warm, deliberate. Not urgent, but solid. The voice of someone settling into something safe. Slight softness at the end, like a commitment made.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: You really are someone precious to me.
lines.style: Quiet, direct. The kind of sincerity that costs something to say out loud. Gentle opening, slight pause before 'precious.' Warm close, no trailing-off — she means it completely.
